headline: Adopted PD Directive 26.01 and an amended policy; Commissioner Finneran was elected Chair unanimously.
summary: Interim Chief Burke presented a report with charts on police data. An anonymous individual asked about private security and crime data by wards. Commissioner Depper stepped down as Chair, and Detective Ellerman received a commendation.
decisions: Approved the draft minutes from May 26th, 2026 unanimously.
Adopted PD Directive 26.01 with all in favor.
Elected Commissioner Finneran as Chair unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Chair Depper moves, Commissioner Finneran seconds, all in favor. Directive 26.01 passes and adopted.
Chair Depper moves to accept the amended policy. Commissioner Finneran seconds. All in favor, passes unanimously.
Unanimous approval, Commissioner Finneran is voted Chair.

decision_titles: Election of Commissioner Finneran as Chair
plain_text:
Police Commission 
Tuesday, July 28th, 2026 
Remote via Zoom and In-person in Contois Auditorium City Hall 
Burlington, Vermont 
DRAFT MINUTES 
 
Members Present: Commissioner Depper, Commissioner Ginorio, Commissioner V on Herman, 
and Commissioner Finneran 
Members Online:  
Staff Present: Interim Chief Burke online, Command Staff Assistant Shibe Couchman online.  
 
1. Agenda  
1.1. Call to Order 
Meeting called to order at 6:00 pm by Commissioner Depper.  
 
1.2. Roll Call and Determination of Quorum 
Required quorum present.  
 
1.3. Motions for Additions or Modifications to Agenda (Time Limited: 15 Minutes) 
Commissioner Paul motions and Chair Depper seconds to add an 8.2 to the proposed executive 
session to include a personnel update. Passes unanimously.  
 
2. Adopt Minutes 
2.1. Motion to Adopt Draft Minutes from May 26th, 2026 
Moved, seconded, approved unanimously. 
 
3. Public Forum (Time Limited: 10 Minutes) 
3.1.The Public is Invited to Address the Commission 
No public comment. 
 
4. Police Department Business (Time Limited: 30 Minutes)  
4.1. Chief’s Report 
Charts supported by data shown and explained by Chief Burke and Jeff Nicholson. Anonymous 
individual asks questions to Chief Burke about private security. Asks for crime data by Wards.  
 
5. Commission Business (Time Limited: 30 Minutes) 
5.1. Committee Reports from All Committees 
Complaints Committee: General Info 
Animal Control Committee 
Second Vicious Dog hearing to take place the following day, July 29th for the dog Raven/Ravin.  
 
5.2. PD Directive Review 
Chair Depper moves, Commissioner Finneran seconds, all in favor. Directive 26.01 passes and 
adopted.
5.3. Resolution, finalization 
Chair Depper moves to accept the amended policy. Commissioner Finneran seconds. All in favor, 
passes unanimously.  
 
5.4. Chair nominations and voting 
Chair Depper announces he is stepping down from his role as Chair and is accepting nominations 
for a new Chair. Commissioner V on Herman nominates Commissioner Paul. Commissioner Paul 
declines and is not willing. Commissioner Ginorio nominates Commissioner Finneran, 
Commissioner Depper seconds. Unanimous approval, Commissioner Finneran is voted Chair. 
Chair Finneran says she feels comfortable serving solo but happy to hear if anyone wants to join. 
Commissioner Depper to complete this meeting as Chair.  
 
6. Commendations (Time Limited: 15 Minutes) 
6.1. Officer Commendations 
Detective Ellerman commendation read aloud.  
 
7. Announcement of Next Meeting Date 
August 25th, 2026.  
 
8. Proposed Executive Session 
8.1. Proposed executive session to discuss confidential complaint information  
8.2. Personnel Updates 
 
9. Adjournment  
9.1. Motion to Adjourn 
The Commission adjourned the public meeting at 6:42pm.
